method: Every frame uses actual resolved visible depth unprojected through its jittered camera. Near surface eligibility is within24m horizontally and fixed GI vertical range. Coverage is inside the complete active GPU field; exact GPU payloads checked separately. Frames with no eligible surface are reported, never counted as covered. No FPS claim.
lightingSourceMethod: Availability means a complete active GI field contains the resolved surface or its exact sky column is present, following voxel shader lookup. This is an availability check, not radiance equivalence; occlusion/readback and rendered screenshots are checked separately.
qualificationScope: Cold flight80 and reversal16 frames have matched eye poses and fixture hashes. Jump/teleport safety-boundary camera differences are listed; those segments have raw statistics only, not matched visual qualification.

renderedSurfaceRGB.method: Actual resolved linear HDR RGB before UI/postprocessing, stride12. Same-pixel probes match only when all world-coordinate differences are at most1/32m. Report unmatched/zero-match frames; never count them as unchanged. Ratios are candidate/baseline luminance; geometry, water, shadows and GI can legitimately change color, so ratios accompany source coverage and rendered image inspection rather than imply radiance equivalence.
renderedSurfaceRGB.farHorizontalMethod: Far natural horizontal surfaces must lie within1/32m of the same integer Y plane, inside the central80percent of the same integer X/Z voxel, and match within1/32m vertically and1/4m horizontally. This excludes vertical faces and voxel edges. This broader terrain check does not qualify subvoxel equivalence; strict1/32m results are retained separately.
